blocks.text: Madonna and Charli xcx, two of music’s most boundary pushing artists have joined forces on a distinctive new track, channeling the spirit of Madonna’s origin-story hit single “Danceteria.” Produced by Madonna, Andrew Watt, Cirkut and Stuart Price, the collaboration is a celebration of the fearless beginnings and influences that shaped each artist’s singular paths. The collaboration follows Madonna and Charli’s CLUB CONFESSIONS party with Saint Laurent during Paris Fashion Week, and a series of playful social media exchanges between the two artists that have since fueled speculation about a potential musical collaboration. “Danceteria Afterhours” out now via Warner Records.
